plugins.name: hr-eval
plugins.description: Evaluate developer candidates by how they think with an AI agent. Logs prompts, tool calls and edits during an interview session, then produces a structured report against 7 signals of developer thinking. HR generates a job-specific task from a JD; candidate runs the session transparently; LLM analyzer produces the report.
